name: Medal of Rescue
descriptionTemplate: At turn start, gain [Arg1] {Glow of Humanity}.
lore: To leave the snow mountain, you adopted a strategy prioritizing efficiency, watching as people fell one by one. The survivors regarded you with more fear than gratitude.

variants.name: Medal of Rescue: Bronze
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At turn start, gain [Arg1] {Glow of Humanity}.
variants.lore: To leave the snow mountain, you adopted a strategy prioritizing efficiency, watching as people fell one by one. The survivors regarded you with more fear than gratitude.

variants.name: Medal of Rescue: Silver
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At the beginning of the turn, gain [Arg1] {Flicker of Humanity}.
variants.lore: You did your best. Though half of them perished, you managed to save the other half. After all, sacrifices are inevitable.

variants.name: Medal of Rescue: Gold
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At turn start, gain [Arg1] {Luster of Humanity}.
variants.lore: You saved most of the people and rewrote their tragic fates. You did your best, didn't you?

variants.name: Medal of Rescue: Platinum
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At the beginning of the turn, gain [Arg1] {Radiance of Humanity}.
variants.lore: Your efforts were worthwhile; you saved almost the entirety of the research team. The survivors are deeply grateful to you.

variants.name: Medal of Rescue: Diamond
variants.label: Event - Special
variants.descriptionTemplate: At turn start, gain [Arg1] {Brilliance of Humanity}.
variants.lore: You've performed an incredible miracle; everyone survived the disaster. You're a great hero, and your legend may soon spread around the snow mountain.
